rule: Direct fish-health or disease work on an eligible salmonid is treated as production-related where it evaluates vaccination, treatment, disease resistance, infection/pathology, or disease control in reared or experimentally held fish, even if the abstract does not explicitly say commercial aquaculture. Exclude wild-only disease surveillance, hatchery/release contexts, studies where the eligible salmonid is only background/comparator, and records where the only salmon evidence is a pathogen name.
refined_boundary: Broad multi-species reviews or composite records in which salmon aquaculture is one component remain for separate policy adjudication.

held_for_policy.reason: Broad marine-introductions review; salmon cage rearing is substantive but mixed with ocean ranching and other taxa.
Broad chapter explicitly contrasts enhancement and aquaculture; needs a policy decision on broad synthesis records.
Composite book contains salmon-aquaculture material, but composite-record rule makes record-level eligibility ambiguous.
